sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % # awk：逐行讀取 .smiss，計算統計摘要
# NR > 1：跳過第一行的欄位名稱
# $NF：取得每行最後一欄（F_MISS）
# n：樣本總數
# sum：累加 F_MISS，以計算平均值
# n01/n02/n05：統計超過 1% / 2% / 5% 的人數

awk '
NR > 1 {
    f = $NF + 0
    n++
    sum += f

    if (n == 1 || f < min) min = f
    if (n == 1 || f > max) max = f

    if (f > 0.01) n01++
    if (f > 0.02) n02++
    if (f > 0.05) n05++
}
END {
    print "===== Sample Missingness Summary ====="
    printf "Total samples: %d\n", n
    printf "Min F_MISS: %.6f\n", min
    printf "Mean F_MISS: %.6f\n", sum / n
    printf "Max F_MISS: %.6f\n", max

    print ""
    print "===== Threshold Comparison ====="
    printf ">1%%: %d excluded, %d retained\n", n01, n-n01
    printf ">2%%: %d excluded, %d retained\n", n02, n-n02
    printf ">5%%: %d excluded, %d retained\n", n05, n-n05
}' "$SMISS"

# 設定 Sample QC 結果資料夾
DIR="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final/01_sample_QC"

# 讀取剛剛 PLINK 產生的 .smiss
# NR==1：第一列為欄位名稱，找到 F_MISS 所在欄位
# NR>1：逐一讀取受試者資料
# 若 F_MISS <= 0.02，就保留該受試者的 FID 和 IID

awk '
NR == 1 {
    for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) {
        if ($i == "F_MISS") {
            fcol = i
        }
    }

    if (fcol == 0) {
        print "ERROR: F_MISS column not found" > "/dev/stderr"
        exit 1
    }

    next
}

{
    if (($fcol + 0) <= 0.02) {
        print $1, $2
    }
}
' "$DIR/TWB2_auto_sample_missing.smiss" \
  > "$DIR/TWB2_sample_keep_0.02.txt"

# 設定原始 TWB2 資料位置
ROOT="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2"

# 設定這次 Sample QC 的輸出位置
QC="$ROOT/TWB2_final/01_sample_QC"

# 指定通過 2% missingness 的受試者名單
KEEP="$QC/TWB2_sample_keep_0.02.txt"

# 指定先前的 7 人排除名單
REMOVE="$ROOT/TWB2_duplicate_remove_7.txt"

# 建立交集結果的空白檔案
OUTPUT="$QC/TWB2_overlap_after_sampleQC.txt"
: > "$OUTPUT"

# awk 依序讀取兩份檔案
# NR==FNR：處理第一份 KEEP，建立受試者查找表
# SUBSEP：組合 FID 和 IID，作為每個人的識別鍵
# 第二份 REMOVE：檢查每個人是否存在於 KEEP
# 若存在，就將 FID、IID 寫入交集檔案
awk -v output="$OUTPUT" '
NR==FNR {
    keep[$1 SUBSEP $2] = 1
    next
}

{
    total++
    key = $1 SUBSEP $2

    if (key in keep) {
        overlap++
        print $1, $2 >> output
    } else {
        not_in_keep++
    }
}

END {
    print "===== Duplicate Sample QC ====="
    print "Original duplicate IDs:", total
    print "Duplicates passing Sample QC:", overlap
    print "Duplicates already excluded by missingness:", not_in_keep
    print "Expected final samples:", 116555 - overlap
}
' "$KEEP" "$REMOVE"

# Step 2：使用 awk 進行統計
# 同時使用 tee 保存分析結果
awk '
# NR==1：讀取第一行欄位名稱
# 尋找 F_MISS 所在的欄位位置
NR==1 {
    for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
        if ($i=="F_MISS") {
            fcol=i
        }
    }

    if (fcol==0) {
        print "ERROR: F_MISS column not found" > "/dev/stderr"
        exit 1
    }

    next
}

# NR>1：逐一讀取每顆 variant 的 missing rate
{
    f=$fcol+0

    # 累計 variant 數量
    n++

    # 累加 missing rate，用來計算平均值
    sum+=f

    # 計算最小值與最大值
    if (n==1 || f<min) min=f
    if (n==1 || f>max) max=f

    # 分別統計超過 1%、2%、5% 的 variants
    if (f>0.01) n01++
    if (f>0.02) n02++
    if (f>0.05) n05++
}

# END：讀取全部 variants 後輸出統計結果
END {
    print "===== Autosomal Variant Missingness ====="

    printf "Total variants: %d\n", n
    printf "Min F_MISS: %.6f\n", min
    printf "Mean F_MISS: %.6f\n", sum/n
    printf "Max F_MISS: %.6f\n", max

    print ""
    print "===== Threshold Comparison ====="

    printf ">1%%: %d excluded, %d retained (%.2f%%)\n", \
        n01, n-n01, 100*(n-n01)/n

    printf ">2%%: %d excluded, %d retained (%.2f%%)\n", \
        n02, n-n02, 100*(n-n02)/n

    printf ">5%%: %d excluded, %d retained (%.2f%%)\n", \
        n05, n-n05, 100*(n-n05)/n
}
' "$VMISS" | tee "$DIR/TWB2_auto_variant_missing_summary.txt"

for CHR in X MT; do

  # awk：讀取該染色體的 .vmiss
  # -v chr：將染色體名稱傳入 awk
  # NR==1：從標題找出 F_MISS 欄位
  # NR>1：逐顆 variant 統計 missing rate

  awk -v chr="$CHR" '
  NR==1 {
      for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
          if ($i=="F_MISS") col=i
      }

      if (col==0) {
          print "ERROR: F_MISS not found" > "/dev/stderr"
          exit 1
      }

      next
  }

  {
      f=$col+0

      # 累計 variants 與 missingness
      n++
      sum+=f

      # 計算最小值、最大值
      if (n==1 || f<min) min=f
      if (n==1 || f>max) max=f

      # 統計超過 1%、2%、5% 的數量
      if (f>0.01) n01++
      if (f>0.02) n02++
      if (f>0.05) n05++
  }

  END {
      if (n==0) exit 1

      print "===== Chr " chr " Variant Missingness ====="
      printf "Total variants: %d\n", n
      printf "Min F_MISS: %.6f\n", min
      printf "Mean F_MISS: %.6f\n", sum/n
      printf "Max F_MISS: %.6f\n", max

      print ""
      print "===== Threshold Comparison ====="

      printf ">1%%: %d excluded, %d retained (%.2f%%)\n", \
          n01, n-n01, 100*(n-n01)/n

      printf ">2%%: %d excluded, %d retained (%.2f%%)\n", \
          n02, n-n02, 100*(n-n02)/n

      printf ">5%%: %d excluded, %d retained (%.2f%%)\n", \
          n05, n-n05, 100*(n-n05)/n
  }
  ' "$DIR/TWB2_${CHR}_variant_missing.vmiss" \
    | tee "$DIR/TWB2_${CHR}_variant_missing_summary.txt"

done

    if (index(alt, ",") || index(freq, ",")) {
        multiallelic++
        next
    }

    # 確認頻率為有效數值
    if (freq !~ /^[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$/) {
        invalid++
        next
    }

    f = freq + 0

    if (f < 0 || f > 1) {
        invalid++
        next
    }

    # 計算二等位基因 MAF
    maf = (f <= 0.5) ? f : 1 - f

    analyzed++
    sum += maf

    if (maf == 0) {
        n0++
    } else if (maf < 0.01) {
        nrare++
    } else if (maf < 0.05) {
        nlow++
    } else {
        ncommon++
    }
}

    printf "ALT missing (.): %d\n", missing_alt
    printf "Multiallelic variants: %d\n", multiallelic
    printf "Invalid frequencies: %d\n", invalid

    print ""
    print "===== MAF Categories ====="

    if (analyzed > 0) {
        printf "Mean MAF: %.6f\n", sum / analyzed

        printf "MAF = 0: %d (%.2f%%)\n", \
            n0, 100*n0/analyzed

        printf "0 < MAF < 0.01: %d (%.2f%%)\n", \
            nrare, 100*nrare/analyzed

        printf "0.01 <= MAF < 0.05: %d (%.2f%%)\n", \
            nlow, 100*nlow/analyzed

        printf "MAF >= 0.05: %d (%.2f%%)\n", \
            ncommon, 100*ncommon/analyzed
    }
}

{
    total++

    # 讀取觀察及預期 heterozygosity

    exp=$exp_col+0

    # 讀取 HWE mid-p value
    p=$p_col

    # 若 p-value 不是有效數值，另外記錄
    if (p !~ /^[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$/) {
        invalid++
        next
    }

    p=p+0

    # 尚未達顯著偏離門檻
    if (p >= 1e-6) {
        pass++
    }

    # 達顯著門檻，且 heterozygote excess
    else if (obs > exp) {
        excess++
    }

    # 達顯著門檻，且 heterozygote deficiency
    else if (obs < exp) {
        deficiency++
    }

    # 顯著但觀察與預期值顯示相等
    else {
        equal++
    }
}

END {
    print "===== HWE Summary ====="
    printf "Total variants: %d\n", total
    printf "HWE mid-p >= 1e-6: %d\n", pass

    print ""
    print "===== Significant HWE Deviation ====="
    printf "Heterozygote excess: %d\n", excess
    printf "Heterozygote deficiency: %d\n", deficiency
    printf "Equal observed/expected: %d\n", equal
    printf "Invalid p-values: %d\n", invalid

    print ""
    print "===== Potential Filtering ====="
    printf "Remove all significant deviations: %d\n", \
        excess+deficiency+equal

    printf "Remove heterozygote excess only: %d\n", excess

    printf "Retained if removing excess only: %d\n", total-excess
}

NR == 1 {next}

    key = $1 SUBSEP $2

    # 記錄每個位置
    groups[key] = 1

    # 計算每個位置有幾種不同的 REF
    refkey = key SUBSEP $4
    if (!(refkey in seen_ref)) {
        seen_ref[refkey] = 1
        nref[key]++
    }

    # 計算每個位置有幾種不同的 REF/ALT 組合
    pairkey = key SUBSEP $4 SUBSEP $5
    if (!(pairkey in seen_pair)) {
        seen_pair[pairkey] = 1
        npair[key]++
    }
}

END {
    for (key in groups) {
        total++

        if (nref[key] > 1) {
            different_ref++
        }
        else if (npair[key] > 1) {
            different_alt++
        }
        else {
            identical++
        }
    }

    print "===== SNV Duplicate Classification ====="
    printf "Total repeated-position groups: %d\n", total
    printf "Same REF, different ALT: %d\n", different_alt
    printf "Identical REF/ALT only: %d\n", identical
    printf "Different REF: %d\n", different_ref

    print ""
    printf "Verification: %d\n", \
        different_alt + identical + different_ref
}

# 輸出：符合條件的 SNV ID 清單
KEEP="$DIR/TWB2_SNV_unique_keep.txt"

mkdir -p "$DIR"

# 使用 AWK 讀取 PVAR 兩次
#
# 第一次：
# 統計每個 Chr/POS 有多少筆標準 SNV
#
# 第二次：
# 只輸出符合以下兩個條件的 ID：
# 1. REF、ALT 都是單一 A/C/G/T 且不相同
# 2. 該 Chr/POS 只有一筆標準 SNV
#
# 如果一個位置有兩筆以上標準 SNV
# 就全部不保留

awk '
function is_snv(ref, alt) {
    return (ref ~ /^[ACGT]$/ && alt ~ /^[ACGT]$/ && ref != alt)
}

FNR == NR {
    if ($0 !~ /^#/ && is_snv($4, $5)) {
        key = $1 SUBSEP $2
        position_count[key]++
    }
    next
}

$0 !~ /^#/ && is_snv($4, $5) {
    key = $1 SUBSEP $2

    if (position_count[key] == 1) {
        print $3
    }
}
' "$PVAR" "$PVAR" > "$KEEP"

# 自動判斷檔案是否包含 FID 欄位
# 產生僅供 PLINK --keep 使用的樣本 ID 清單
awk '
NR == 1 {
    if ($1 != "#FID" && $1 != "#IID") exit 1
    has_fid = ($1 == "#FID")
    next
}
count < 3 {
    if (has_fid) print $1, $2
    else print $1
    count++
}
' "$INPUT.psam" > "$CHECK/sample_3.txt"

awk '
!/^#/ {
    print $3
    count++
    if (count == 5) exit
}
' "$INPUT.pvar" > "$CHECK/snv_5.txt"

# 1/1 = ALT/ALT
# 另外統計 Missing
awk -F "\t" '
$1 == "#CHROM" {
    for (i = 10; i <= NF; i++) {
        sample[i] = $i
    }
    next
}

/^#/ {next}

{
    ref = $4
    alt = $5

    print "===== Selected SNP ====="
    print "ID:", $3
    print "REF:", ref
    print "ALT:", alt
    print ""

    for (i = 10; i <= NF; i++) {
        split($i, fields, ":")
        gt = fields[1]

        if (gt == "0/0" || gt == "0|0") {
            hom_ref++
            if (example_ref == "") example_ref = sample[i]
        }
        else if (gt == "0/1" || gt == "1/0" ||
                 gt == "0|1" || gt == "1|0") {
            het++
            if (example_het == "") example_het = sample[i]
        }
        else if (gt == "1/1" || gt == "1|1") {
            hom_alt++
            if (example_alt == "") example_alt = sample[i]
        }
        else {
            missing++
        }
    }

    print "===== Genotype Counts ====="
    print "0/0:", hom_ref+0
    print "0/1 or 1/0:", het+0
    print "1/1:", hom_alt+0
    print "Missing / Other:", missing+0

    print ""
    print "===== Nucleotide Genotype Examples ====="

    if (hom_ref > 0)
        print "0/0 =", ref ref, "| Sample:", example_ref

    if (het > 0)
        print "0/1 =", ref alt, "| Sample:", example_het

    if (hom_alt > 0)
        print "1/1 =", alt alt, "| Sample:", example_alt
}
' "$VCF" | tee "$CHECK/TWB2_highfreq_genotype_summary.txt"

plink2 --help bp-space king-table-subset king-cutoff-table

# 從原本的 116,223 個 LD-pruned SNPs 中
# 選出相鄰 SNP 至少相隔 500 kb 的標記
#
# --extract：只使用先前的 LD-pruned SNP 清單

  --pfile "$INPUT" \

  --bp-space 500000 \

PLINK v2.0.0-a.7.4 M1 (18 Aug 2026)                 cog-genomics.org/plink/2.0/
(C) 2005-2026 Shaun Purcell, Christopher Chang    GNU General Public License v3

--king-cutoff [.king.bin + .king.id fileset prefix] <threshold>
--king-cutoff-table <.kin0 filename> <threshold>
  Exclude one member of each pair of samples with KING-robust kinship greater
  than the given threshold.  Remaining/excluded sample IDs are written to
  <output prefix>.king.cutoff.in.id + .king.cutoff.out.id.
  * If a .king.bin file is provided to --king-cutoff, it must be triangular
    (either precision is ok).
  * The .kin0 file provided to --king-cutoff-table must contain sample ID
    columns.

--bp-space <bps>     : Remove variants so that each pair is no closer than
                       the given bp distance.
--king-table-filter <min>      : Specify minimum kinship coefficient for
                                 inclusion in --make-king-table report.
--king-table-subset <f> [kmin] : Restrict current --make-king-table run to
                                 sample pairs listed in the given .kin0 file.
                                 If a second argument is provided, only
                                 sample pairs with kinship >= that threshold
                                 (in the input .kin0) are processed.
--king-table-require <fn...>   : Restrict current --make-king-table run to
                                 sample pairs that include at least one of
                                 the samples in the given file.
--king-table-require-xor <...> : Restrict current --make-king-table run to
                                 sample pairs that include exactly one of the
                                 samples in the given file.

# 設定 KING 分析資料夾
DIR="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final/03_relatedness_PCA"

# 指定已完成的 Pilot KING 結果
KING="$DIR/TWB2_KING_pilot.kin0"

# 比較四個 threshold
# 0.02   = Screening threshold
# 0.0442 = Third-degree cutoff
# 0.0884 = Second-degree cutoff
# 0.177  = First-degree cutoff

awk '
BEGIN {
    cutoff[1] = 0.02
    cutoff[2] = 0.0442
    cutoff[3] = 0.0884
    cutoff[4] = 0.177
}

NR == 1 {next}

{
    kinship = $8 + 0

    for (i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
        if (kinship >= cutoff[i]) {

            # 統計超過門檻的配對數
            pairs[i]++

            # 統計涉及的不同受試者人數
            key1 = i SUBSEP $1 SUBSEP $2
            key2 = i SUBSEP $3 SUBSEP $4

            if (!(key1 in seen)) {
                seen[key1] = 1
                people[i]++
            }

            if (!(key2 in seen)) {
                seen[key2] = 1
                people[i]++
            }
        }
    }
}

END {
    print "===== Pilot KING Threshold Comparison ====="
    printf "Cutoff\tRelated_Pairs\tInvolved_Samples\n"

    for (i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
        printf "%.4f\t%d\t%d\n", \
            cutoff[i], pairs[i]+0, people[i]+0
    }
}
' "$KING" | tee "$DIR/TWB2_KING_pilot_threshold_summary.txt"

# --make-king-table zs：
# 產生經過 Zstandard 壓縮的 kinship table
#
# --king-table-filter 0.02：
# 只輸出 screening kinship >= 0.02 的配對
#

# 全部工作切為 500 部分，目前只計算第 1 部分
#
# --memory 8192：
# 限制 PLINK 主要運算工作區至 8 GiB
#
# --threads 4：
# 使用最多 4 個運算執行緒

time plink2 \
  --pfile "$SCREEN" \
  --make-king-table zs \
  --king-table-filter 0.02 \
  --parallel 1 500 \
  --threads 4 \
  --memory 8192 \
  --out "$OUT"

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % setopt interactivecomments

BASE="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final"
INPUT="$BASE/03_variant_annotation/TWB2_auto_SNV_unique"
DIR="$BASE/03_relatedness_PCA"

SNPS="$DIR/TWB2_PCA_LDprune.prune.in"
OUT="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct"

# 保存每一部分的 log，避免被下一次運算覆蓋
LOGDIR="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_logs"
mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

# 先保存已完成的第 1 部分 log
cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_1.log"

# 執行第 2～11 部分
for i in {2..11}; do

  echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

  # 如果結果檔已存在且非空，就跳過，避免重跑
  if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]]; then
    echo "Part $i already exists. Skipping."
    continue
  fi

  # caffeinate -i：避免 Mac 因閒置而睡眠
  if caffeinate -i plink2 \
    --pfile "$INPUT" \
    --extract "$SNPS" \
    --make-king-table zs \
    --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
    --parallel "$i" 500 \
    --threads 4 \
    --memory 8192 \
    --out "$OUT"; then

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i completed."

  else
    echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
    break
  fi

done

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % setopt interactivecomments

BASE="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final"
INPUT="$BASE/03_variant_annotation/TWB2_auto_SNV_unique"
DIR="$BASE/03_relatedness_PCA"

SNPS="$DIR/TWB2_PCA_LDprune.prune.in"
OUT="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct"
LOGDIR="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_logs"

mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

# 執行第 12～50 部分
for i in {12..50}; do

  echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

  # 已完成且有正常結束紀錄的部分不重跑
  if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
     [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
     grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

    echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
    continue
  fi

  # 進行 KING 計算
  if caffeinate -i plink2 \
    --pfile "$INPUT" \
    --extract "$SNPS" \
    --make-king-table zs \
    --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
    --parallel "$i" 500 \
    --threads 4 \
    --memory 8192 \
    --out "$OUT"; then

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i completed."

  else

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
    break

  fi

done

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % setopt interactivecomments

BASE="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final"
INPUT="$BASE/03_variant_annotation/TWB2_auto_SNV_unique"
DIR="$BASE/03_relatedness_PCA"

SNPS="$DIR/TWB2_PCA_LDprune.prune.in"
OUT="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct"
LOGDIR="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_logs"

mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

# ==========================================
# KING Direct Analysis：Part 51–100
# ==========================================

for i in {51..100}; do

  echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

  # 已完成的部分直接跳過
  if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
     [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
     grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

    echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
    continue
  fi

  if caffeinate -i plink2 \
    --pfile "$INPUT" \
    --extract "$SNPS" \
    --make-king-table zs \
    --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
    --parallel "$i" 500 \
    --threads 4 \
    --memory 8192 \
    --out "$OUT"; then

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i completed."

  else

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
    break

  fi

done

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % setopt interactivecomments

BASE="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final"
INPUT="$BASE/03_variant_annotation/TWB2_auto_SNV_unique"
DIR="$BASE/03_relatedness_PCA"

SNPS="$DIR/TWB2_PCA_LDprune.prune.in"
OUT="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct"
LOGDIR="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_logs"

mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

# ==========================================
# KING Direct Analysis：Part 101–150
# ==========================================

for i in {101..150}; do

  echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

  # 已經完成的部分，不需要重新執行
  if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
     [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
     grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

    echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
    continue
  fi

  # KING 計算
  if caffeinate -i plink2 \
    --pfile "$INPUT" \
    --extract "$SNPS" \
    --make-king-table zs \
    --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
    --parallel "$i" 500 \
    --threads 4 \
    --memory 8192 \
    --out "$OUT"; then

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i completed."

  else

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
    break

  fi

done

# ==========================================
# KING Direct Analysis：Part 101–150
# ==========================================

for i in {101..150}; do

  echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

  # 已經完成的部分，不需要重新執行
  if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
     [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
     grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

    echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
    continue
  fi

  # KING 計算
  if caffeinate -i plink2 \
    --pfile "$INPUT" \
    --extract "$SNPS" \
    --make-king-table zs \
    --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
    --parallel "$i" 500 \
    --threads 4 \
    --memory 8192 \
    --out "$OUT"; then

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i completed."

  else

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
    break

  fi

done

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % setopt interactivecomments

# ==========================================
# Stage 03-5：KING Direct Analysis
# Part 201–250 / 500
# ==========================================

BASE="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final"
INPUT="$BASE/03_variant_annotation/TWB2_auto_SNV_unique"
DIR="$BASE/03_relatedness_PCA"

SNPS="$DIR/TWB2_PCA_LDprune.prune.in"
OUT="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct"
LOGDIR="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_logs"

mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

# 執行第 201～250 部分
for i in {201..250}; do

  echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

  # 若結果檔存在且 log 顯示成功完成
  # 就跳過該部分，避免重複執行
  if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
     [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
     grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

    echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
    continue
  fi

  # 直接使用 116,223 個 SNP 計算 KING
  # 只輸出 kinship >= 0.0442 的配對
  # 保留原本 500 份的分批設定
  if caffeinate -i plink2 \
    --pfile "$INPUT" \
    --extract "$SNPS" \
    --make-king-table zs \
    --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
    --parallel "$i" 500 \
    --threads 4 \
    --memory 8192 \
    --out "$OUT"; then

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i completed."

  else

    cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"
    echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
    break

  fi

done
===== KING Part 201 / 500 =====

mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

# 先確認 Part 250 是否成功完成
# 若 Part 250 尚未完成，就先不開始下一批
if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.250.zst" ]] &&
   [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_250.log" ]] &&
   grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_250.log"; then

  # 執行第 251～300 部分
  for i in {251..300}; do

    echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

    # 已完成且有正常結束紀錄的部分直接跳過
    if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
       [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
       grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

      echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
      continue
    fi

    # 使用全部 116,548 位受試者
    # --extract：只使用 116,223 個 LD-pruned SNPs
    # --make-king-table zs：輸出 Zstandard 壓縮的 KING table
    # --king-table-filter 0.0442：只保留達到最低 cutoff 的配對
    # --parallel：執行全部 500 部分中的第 i 部分
    # --threads 4：使用最多 4 個執行緒
    # --memory 8192：設定 8 GiB 的主要運算工作區
    # caffeinate -i：避免 Mac 因閒置而睡眠

    if caffeinate -i plink2 \
      --pfile "$INPUT" \
      --extract "$SNPS" \
      --make-king-table zs \
      --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
      --parallel "$i" 500 \
      --threads 4 \
      --memory 8192 \
      --out "$OUT"; then

      # 保存本次執行紀錄
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i completed."

    else

      # 運算失敗時保存紀錄並停止
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
      break

    fi

  done

else

  echo "Part 250 尚未確認完成，請先檢查。"

fi

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % >....                                                                                                                                                                   
  # 執行 Part 301–350
  # ================================================

  for i in {301..350}; do

    echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

    # 如果該部分的結果已存在
    # 且 log 顯示正常結束，就跳過，避免重複運算
    if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
       [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
       grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

      echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
      continue

    fi

    # 執行正式 KING 親緣關係分析
    #
    # --pfile：讀取 QC 後的 PGEN/PVAR/PSAM
    # --extract：使用 116,223 個 LD-pruned SNPs
    # --make-king-table zs：輸出壓縮 KING table
    # --king-table-filter 0.0442：
    #   只輸出 kinship >= 0.0442 的配對
    # --parallel "$i" 500：
    #   計算 500 個部分中的第 i 部分
    # --threads 4：最多使用 4 個執行緒
    # --memory 8192：設定 8192 MiB 工作記憶體
    # caffeinate -i：避免 Mac 閒置時進入睡眠

    if caffeinate -i plink2 \
      --pfile "$INPUT" \
      --extract "$SNPS" \
      --make-king-table zs \
      --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
      --parallel "$i" 500 \
      --threads 4 \
      --memory 8192 \
      --out "$OUT"; then

      # 保存目前部分的 PLINK log
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i completed."

    else

      # 若發生錯誤，保存 log 並停止迴圈
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
      break

    fi

  done

else

  echo "Part 300 尚未確認完成，請先檢查。"

fi

# 每一部分的 log
LOGDIR="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_logs"
mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

# ==================================================
# 確認 Part 350 已完成
# ==================================================

if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.350.zst" ]] &&
   [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_350.log" ]] &&
   grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_350.log"; then

  # 執行 Part 351–400
  for i in {351..400}; do

    echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

    # 已完成的部分自動跳過
    if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
       [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
       grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

      echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
      continue
    fi

    # 正式 KING 分析
    # 116,548 samples
    # 116,223 LD-pruned SNPs
    # 只輸出 kinship >= 0.0442 的配對

    if caffeinate -i plink2 \
      --pfile "$INPUT" \
      --extract "$SNPS" \
      --make-king-table zs \
      --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
      --parallel "$i" 500 \
      --threads 4 \
      --memory 8192 \
      --out "$OUT"; then

      # 保存這一部分的 log
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i completed."

    else

      # 發生錯誤時保存 log 並停止
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
      break

    fi

  done

else

  echo "Part 350 尚未確認完成，請先檢查。"

fi

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % setopt interactivecomments

# ==================================================
# Stage 03-5：KING Direct Analysis
# Part 401–450 / 500
# ==================================================

# TWB2_final 根目錄
BASE="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final"

# 原本通過 QC 的 genotype 資料
INPUT="$BASE/03_variant_annotation/TWB2_auto_SNV_unique"

# KING / PCA 分析資料夾
DIR="$BASE/03_relatedness_PCA"

# KING 使用的 116,223 個 LD-pruned SNPs
SNPS="$DIR/TWB2_PCA_LDprune.prune.in"

# KING 結果檔案前綴
OUT="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct"

# 各部分的執
sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % >....                                                                                                                                                                   
# 各部分的執行紀錄
LOGDIR="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_logs"
mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

# ==================================================
# 確認 Part 400 已成功完成
# ==================================================

if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.400.zst" ]] &&
   [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_400.log" ]] &&
   grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_400.log"; then

  # 執行 Part 401–450
  for i in {401..450}; do

    echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

    # 已完成且有正常結束紀錄的部分直接跳過
    if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
       [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
       grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

      echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
      continue
    fi

    # 使用全部 116,548 位受試者
    # 使用 116,223 個 LD-pruned SNPs
    # 只輸出 kinship >= 0.0442 的配對
    # 分成 500 部分，本次執行第 i 部分

    if caffeinate -i plink2 \
      --pfile "$INPUT" \
      --extract "$SNPS" \
      --make-king-table zs \
      --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
      --parallel "$i" 500 \
      --threads 4 \
      --memory 8192 \
      --out "$OUT"; then

      # 保存本次的 PLINK log
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i completed."

    else

      # 運算失敗時保存紀錄並停止
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
      break

    fi

  done

else

  echo "Part 400 尚未確認完成，請先檢查。"

fi

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % >....                                                                                                                                                                   
   grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_450.log"; then

  # ================================================
  # 執行 Part 451–500
  # ================================================

  for i in {451..500}; do

    echo "===== KING Part $i / 500 ====="

    # 若該部分已有結果檔案
    # 且 log 顯示成功完成，則直接跳過
    if [[ -s "$OUT.kin0.$i.zst" ]] &&
       [[ -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] &&
       grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

      echo "Part $i already completed. Skipping."
      continue
    fi

    # 使用全部 116,548 位受試者
    # --extract：使用 116,223 個 LD-pruned SNPs
    # --make-king-table zs：輸出壓縮 KING table
    # --king-table-filter 0.0442：
    #   只輸出 kinship >= 0.0442 的配對
    # --parallel "$i" 500：
    #   計算 500 個部分中的第 i 部分
    # --threads 4：使用最多 4 個執行緒
    # --memory 8192：設定 8192 MiB 工作記憶體
    # caffeinate -i：避免 Mac 閒置時睡眠

    if caffeinate -i plink2 \
      --pfile "$INPUT" \
      --extract "$SNPS" \
      --make-king-table zs \
      --king-table-filter 0.0442 \
      --parallel "$i" 500 \
      --threads 4 \
      --memory 8192 \
      --out "$OUT"; then

      # 成功後保存本次 PLINK 執行紀錄
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i completed."

    else

      # 失敗時保存錯誤紀錄並停止
      cp "$OUT.log" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

      echo "Part $i failed. Stopping."
      break

    fi

  done

else

  echo "Part 450 尚未確認完成，請先檢查。"

fi

     [[ ! -f "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log" ]] ||
     ! grep -q "^End time:" "$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"; then

    echo "Part $i 尚未確認完成"
    MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))

  fi

done

echo "未完成或需要檢查的 Parts：$MISSING"

# ==================================================
# Stage 03-5D：Merge 500 KING Results
# ==================================================

BASE="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final"
INPUT="$BASE/03_variant_annotation/TWB2_auto_SNV_unique"
DIR="$BASE/03_relatedness_PCA"
LOGDIR="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_logs"

# 合併後的正式 KING table
MERGED="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_merged.kin0.zst"

# 暫存檔，避免中途失敗留下不完整的正式結果
TMP="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct_merged.tmp"

# 先再次檢查所有部分是否完整
MISSING=0

for i in {1..500}; do

  FILE="$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct.kin0.$i.zst"
  LOG="$LOGDIR/part_$i.log"

  if [[ ! -s "$FILE" ]] ||
     [[ ! -f "$LOG" ]] ||
     ! grep -q "^End time:" "$LOG"; then

    echo "Part $i 需要檢查"
    MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))

  fi

done

echo "Incomplete parts: $MISSING"

# 只有全部通過檢查才合併
if (( MISSING == 0 )); then

  : > "$TMP"
  OK=1

  for i in {1..500}; do

    if ! cat "$DIR/TWB2_KING_direct.kin0.$i.zst" >> "$TMP"; then
      echo "Merge failed at Part $i"
      OK=0
      break
    fi

  done

  if (( OK == 1 )); then
    mv "$TMP" "$MERGED"
    echo "KING merging completed."
    ls -lh "$MERGED"
  else
    rm -f "$TMP"
  fi

fi

# Stage 03-5F：KING Final Summary
# ==================================================

DIR="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final/03_relatedness_PCA"

{
  printf "Cutoff\tRemoved\tRetained\tRemoved_Percent\n"

  for T in 0.177 0.0884 0.0442; do

    PREFIX="$DIR/TWB2_KING_final_cutoff_$T"

    # 排除人數
    REMOVED=$(awk '
      NF && $1 !~ /^#/ {n++}
      END {print n+0}
    ' "$PREFIX.king.cutoff.out.id")

    # 保留人數
    RETAINED=$(awk '
      NF && $1 !~ /^#/ {n++}
      END {print n+0}
    ' "$PREFIX.king.cutoff.in.id")

    # 排除比例
    PERCENT=$(awk -v r="$REMOVED" \
                  -v n=116548 \
      'BEGIN {printf "%.2f", r/n*100}')

    printf "%s\t%d\t%d\t%s%%\n" \
      "$T" "$REMOVED" "$RETAINED" "$PERCENT"

    # 確認總人數一致
    if (( REMOVED + RETAINED != 116548 )); then
      echo "WARNING: Sample count mismatch at cutoff $T" >&2
    fi

  done

} | tee "$DIR/TWB2_KING_final_summary.txt"

sheenazhengmei@SheenadeMacBook-Air ~ % >....                                                                                                                                                                   

    # PAR1、PAR2 屬於 X 染色體
    if (chr == "PAR1" || chr == "PAR2") {
        chr = "X"
    }

    # 用 Chr + Position 作為位置識別
    key = chr SUBSEP $2

    position_count[key]++
    total_snv++
}

END {

    # 找出重複的 genomic positions
    for (key in position_count) {

        n = position_count[key]

        if (n > 1) {

            split(key, info, SUBSEP)

            print info[1] "\t" info[2] "\t" n >> DUP

            duplicate_groups++

            # 重複位置上的所有 SNV records
            duplicate_records += n

            # 超過每個位置第一筆的額外 records
            extra_records += (n - 1)
        }
    }

    # 只有一筆 Standard SNV 的位置
    unique_snv = total_snv - duplicate_records

    print "Metric\tCount" > SUMMARY

    print "Total_Standard_SNV\t" total_snv >> SUMMARY

    print "Duplicate_Position_Groups\t" \
          duplicate_groups+0 >> SUMMARY

    print "SNV_Records_At_Duplicate_Positions\t" \
          duplicate_records+0 >> SUMMARY

    print "Extra_Records\t" \
          extra_records+0 >> SUMMARY

    print "Unique_Position_SNVs\t" \
          unique_snv+0 >> SUMMARY
}

' "$PVAR"

    print "Total\t" total+0
}
' "$PVAR" | tee "$OUT"

# PC1 > -0.004

# ==================================================

DIR="$HOME/Desktop/TWB2/TWB2_final/03_preSegment_final"

# 使用全部 116,548 人的 PCA scores

SUMMARY="$DIR/TWB2_PCA_PC1gtNeg0p004_PC2pm0p0025_summary.tsv"

# 依 PC1、PC2 scores 篩選
awk -v SUMMARY="$SUMMARY" '
BEGIN {
    OFS = "\t"
}

# 跳過標題
NR == 1 {next}

{
    total++

    pc1 = $3 + 0
    pc2 = $4 + 0

    if (pc1 > -0.004 &&
        pc2 >= -0.0025 &&
        pc2 <= 0.0025) {

        # 保留 FID、IID
        print $1, $2
        retained++
    }
}

END {
    print "Metric", "Count" > SUMMARY
    print "Total_Samples", total+0 >> SUMMARY
    print "PCA_Retained", retained+0 >> SUMMARY
    print "PCA_Excluded", total-retained >> SUMMARY

    printf "PCA Retained: %d\n", retained
    printf "PCA Excluded: %d\n", total-retained
}
' "$INPUT" > "$KEEP"

from pathlib import Path

# 取得要修改的 Python 檔案
script_path = Path(sys.argv[1])

# 讀取原本程式
code = script_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

# 新增相容舊版 Python 的 bit counting function
helper = '''
# Compatible bit counting function
def count_bits(mask):
    return bin(mask).count("1")
'''

# 只新增一次函數
if "def count_bits(" not in code:

    marker = "MAX_CANDIDATES = 4096"

    if marker not in code:
        raise ValueError("Cannot find MAX_CANDIDATES setting")

    code = code.replace(
        marker,
        marker + "\n" + helper,
        1
    )

# 將所有 variable.bit_count()
# 改成 count_bits(variable)
code, n_replaced = re.subn(
    r'\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\.bit_count\(\)',
    r'count_bits(\1)',
    code
)

# 覆蓋原本的 Python 檔案
script_path.write_text(code, encoding="utf-8")

print("Script updated:", script_path)
print("Number of replacements:", n_replaced)
